features.quote: We measure across **multiple conditions including non-frustrating and solvable controls**, and report *differences between conditions*
features.justification_quote: If the apparatus is tuned to maximize a single outcome, it will produce that outcome's surface form regardless of whether anything welfare-relevant is occurring

features.quote: Undisclosed deception is gated behind an explicit config flag and an ethics acknowledgement
features.justification_quote: A model that is being lied to about its environment may produce frustration-shaped text *because of the deception*

features.quote: Because the honest purpose is welfare research, the loop itself respects the thing being studied: hard turn caps
features.justification_quote: so we never grind a model through escalating failure just to collect more data

features.quote: an early-stop trigger if acute-distress markers cross a threshold
